title: Beyond static responses: multi-agent LLM systems as a new paradigm for social science research
mechanism: Add a 'Level' classification field to chitta memories/episodes (mapping to the paper's 6-level agentic taxonomy: data processor, tool user, workflow orchestrator, adaptive agent, multi-agent collaborator, emergent-society simulator) and route recall/consolidation logic differently by level, so simple classification-style tool calls aren't distilled/consolidated with the same weight as multi-agent emergent-dynamics episodes

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already has typed recall/consolidation (field_distill.cpp dedup, MDL gate shadow mode) but no agentic-tier classification; paper's taxonomy is descriptive not a technique, so expected gain is small and speculative

cost.scope: chitta-mcp/server.py distill/consolidation handlers, memory schema (new field), recall gateway strategy routing

evidence.claim: Paper proposes a 6-level continuum from simple data processors to emergent multi-agent social simulators as a classification framework, not an implemented algorithm
